title: ProviderState
description: A ModelProvider's capacity as the operator last probed it, in the kubemoot_provider_state bucket, key <provider>.

endpoint.description: Its model server URL. Empty for a provider that runs one server per model (vLLM); those servers are listed in modelEndpoints.

modelEndpoints.description: The server URL a call for each model goes to, by model, for a provider that runs one server per model (vLLM). Absent means every model is served at endpoint.

engine.description: Its model server's engine type, from ModelProvider spec.type (for example ollama); absent means ollama. Agents pick how to call the server by it.

maxParallel.description: How many calls it serves at once; at least 1.

activeCount.description: Calls in progress. The operator writes 0; tickets carry the live count.

ready.description: Whether the provider answered its probe.

lastProbedAt.description: When the operator wrote this entry, RFC 3339 in UTC. Readers treat an entry older than five minutes as stale.

loadedModelFootprintsMiB.description: Memory each loaded model takes, in MiB, by model.

availableModelFootprintsMiB.description: Size of each model the provider has but has not loaded, in MiB, by model.

contextLength.description: The provider's default context window, in tokens.

loadedModelContextLengths.description: The context window each loaded model runs with, in tokens, by model.

modelStates.description: Where each model stands on the provider, by model: awake (loaded and answering now), asleep (parked by the engine and quick to wake, for engines that sleep models), or available (the provider has it but it is not loaded). Ollama fills it from its loaded and downloaded models; engines that sleep models fill asleep from the server. Absent means the provider did not report states; readers then use loadedModels. Describes a provider that may be a pool of servers, not one process.

requestsRunning.description: Requests the engine is running now, across the whole provider. Filled by engines that export it (the Model Server Protocol metrics); Ollama exports none, so it is absent and the tickets carry the live count.

requestsWaiting.description: Requests the engine holds in its own queue, across the whole provider. Filled by engines that export it; absent for Ollama.

kvCacheUsage.description: Fraction of the engine's key-value cache in use, 0 to 1, across the whole provider. Filled by engines that export it; absent for Ollama, which does not.

switchCostMs.description: How long the provider last took to make each model ready, in milliseconds, by model, as observed (a load, or a wake from sleep). Absent means not observed; the calibrated loadMs in modelSpeeds is the fallback.

hostMemoryParkedMiB.description: Host memory in MiB holding the weights of models the engine has put to sleep. Filled by engines that park weights in host memory; absent for Ollama.

loadMs.description: How long the engine took to load the model when calibrated, in milliseconds; 0 when not measured.

promptTokensPerSecond.description: Prompt processing speed calibration measured; 0 when not measured.

generateTokensPerSecond.description: Generation speed of one request calibration measured.

observedGenerateTokensPerSecond.description: Median generation speed of warm crew calls that ran alone on the provider since the calibration; 0 with too few such calls to trust.

observedSamples.description: How many such calls the observed median is over.

modelSpeeds.description: What each model costs on the provider, by model: what calibration measured, and how fast crew calls have run since. Only models calibration found to fit.
